verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.155
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 5.155

verses.pali: 16. Saddhammavagga
verses.english: 16. The True Teaching

verses.pali: Dutiyasaddhammasammosasutta
verses.english: The Decline of the True Teaching (2nd)

verses.pali: “Pañcime, bhikkhave, dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these five things lead to the decline and disappearance of the true teaching.

verses.pali: Katame pañca?
verses.english: What five?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhū dhammaṁ na pariyāpuṇanti—
verses.english: It’s when the mendicants don’t memorize the teaching—

verses.pali: suttaṁ, geyyaṁ, veyyākaraṇaṁ, gāthaṁ, udānaṁ, itivuttakaṁ, jātakaṁ, abbhutadhammaṁ, vedallaṁ.
verses.english: statements, mixed prose & verse, discussions, verses, inspired exclamations, legends, stories of past lives, amazing stories, and elaborations.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo dhammo saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the first thing that leads to the decline and disappearance of the true teaching.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū yathāsutaṁ yathāpariyattaṁ dhammaṁ na vitthārena paresaṁ desenti.
verses.english: Furthermore, the mendicants don’t explain the teaching in detail to others as they learned and memorized it.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, dutiyo dhammo saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the second thing …

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū yathāsutaṁ yathāpariyattaṁ dhammaṁ na vitthārena paraṁ vācenti.
verses.english: Furthermore, the mendicants don’t make others recite the teaching in detail as they learned and memorized it.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, tatiyo dhammo saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the third thing …

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū yathāsutaṁ yathāpariyattaṁ dhammaṁ na vitthārena sajjhāyaṁ karonti.
verses.english: Furthermore, the mendicants don’t rehearse the teaching in detail as they learned and memorized it.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, catuttho dhammo saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the fourth thing …

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū yathāsutaṁ yathāpariyattaṁ dhammaṁ na cetasā anuvitakkenti anuvicārenti manasānupekkhanti.
verses.english: Furthermore, the mendicants don’t think about and consider the teaching in their hearts, examining it with their minds as they learned and memorized it.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, pañcamo dhammo saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the fifth thing that leads to the decline and disappearance of the true teaching.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: These five things lead to the decline and disappearance of the true teaching.

verses.pali: Pañcime, bhikkhave, dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: These five things lead to the continuation, persistence, and enduring of the true teaching.

verses.pali: Katame pañca?
verses.english: What five?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhū dhammaṁ pariyāpuṇanti—
verses.english: It’s when the mendicants memorize the teaching—

verses.pali: suttaṁ, geyyaṁ, veyyākaraṇaṁ, gāthaṁ, udānaṁ, itivuttakaṁ, jātakaṁ, abbhutadhammaṁ, vedallaṁ.
verses.english: statements, mixed prose & verse, discussions, verses, inspired exclamations, legends, stories of past lives, amazing stories, and elaborations.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo dhammo saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the first thing that leads to the continuation, persistence, and enduring of the true teaching.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū yathāsutaṁ yathāpariyattaṁ dhammaṁ vitthārena paresaṁ desenti.
verses.english: Furthermore, the mendicants explain the teaching in detail to others as they learned and memorized it.

verses.english: This is the second thing …

verses.english: Furthermore, the mendicants make others recite the teaching in detail as they learned and memorized it.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, tatiyo dhammo saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the third thing …

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū yathāsutaṁ yathāpariyattaṁ dhammaṁ vitthārena sajjhāyaṁ karonti.
verses.english: Furthermore, the mendicants rehearse the teaching in detail as they learned and memorized it.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, catuttho dhammo saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the fourth thing …

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū yathāsutaṁ yathāpariyattaṁ dhammaṁ cetasā anuvitakkenti anuvicārenti manasānupekkhanti.
verses.english: Furthermore, the mendicants think about and consider the teaching in their hearts, examining it with their minds as they learned and memorized it.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, pañcamo dhammo saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: This is the fifth thing that leads to the continuation, persistence, and enduring of the true teaching.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṁvattantī”ti.
verses.english: These five things lead to the continuation, persistence, and enduring of the true teaching.”

verses.pali: Pañcamaṁ.
